methods_paragraph_draft: Human annotation effort included Tier-1 NEG QC (18/18 clauses), Tier-2 spot-check (11 clauses), Tier-3 dual-rater mini-IAA (120 clauses, 240 annotations, κ=0.96), and Step G aspect gold audit (297 clauses, κ≈0.95). This dual-lane design separates aspect validation (T2) from sentiment validation (T3) while keeping silver-scale pipeline labels for descriptive analytics on n=1,742 extended clauses.
